section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining a model of body appreciation among college women. The study explored how interpersonal factors (adult attachment, caregiver eating messages) and intrapersonal factors (maladaptive and adaptive perfectionism) relate to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating and depressive symptoms. Body appreciation played a key mediational role in the model, fully accounting for the relationship between discrepancy perfectionism and intuitive eating, and partially accounting for links from attachment anxiety and restrictive caregiver eating messages to intuitive eating.
